description: Quarantined pre-existing DRY duplication. This file exists so that historical debt is recorded explicitly - with an owner and a linked issue - instead of being folded invisibly into dry_duplication_baseline.json by a wholesale regeneration, which would have blessed all 511 fingerprints in one commit and destroyed the ratchet. Each count is the number of occurrences observed on 2026-08-16 and is a CEILING: a quarantined fingerprint may shrink but never grow, and any fingerprint absent from both this file and the baseline still fails at the first duplicate. Entries are expected to be deleted as clusters are reconciled; see #8695 for the reconciliation plan.
reason: Historical duplication that accumulated after the baseline was last regenerated on 2026-06-17 (69deb578c, #7620), while CI Standard never reached a conclusion and nothing was watching this gate. Tranche 2 (#8763): duplication shipped into the Tools-shadow packages (model_generation, humanoid_character_builder, sidekick, security, ai) by consolidations that merged while the required quality-gate context was satisfied by lightweight workflows and the real aggregate, including this ratchet, was failing (see the 26/26 audit on PR #8747). Recorded explicitly per this ledger's charter rather than folded into the baseline.
